samples.title: Complete CPU note
samples.text: The CPU contains an ALU for calculations and comparisons, a control unit that directs operations, and registers that temporarily hold working data and results.

samples.title: Partial CPU note
samples.text: The arithmetic and logic unit carries out calculations and logical comparisons in the CPU.

samples.title: Unrelated note
samples.text: A plotter draws detailed plans on paper, while speakers produce sound output.

samples.title: Conflicting RAM/ROM note
samples.text: RAM permanently retains the boot instructions without electricity. ROM is the temporary workspace that is erased whenever power is removed.

samples.title: Complete DNS note
samples.text: DNS translates a domain name, such as school.example, into the corresponding IP address. The computer can then use that address to connect to the requested server.

samples.title: Conflicting email note
samples.text: Cc sends copies to additional recipients. Bcc also sends copies, but every To and Cc recipient can see the Bcc address list.
